reuse.why: The tree already routes the weekend rule through getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip rule is written as a separate inline filter in getNextDate instead of extending that shared weekend helper.

duplication.why: The isWeekend filter is repeated for the forward and reverse lookups inside getNextDate, and the daily/skipWeekend condition re-derives what the weekend helper's callers already decide.

placement.why: The change is in shared/schedules.ts, the right module, but in getNextDate rather than in the weekend-rule function the other paths (getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) call.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and a matching test are touched.

maintainability.why: The daily rule now exists only in one of several weekend-handling paths, relies on a magic take of 14 and reads frequency from the raw condition, so upcoming-date previews and budget templates silently keep moving daily weekend occurrences.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate filters weekend dates itself instead of changing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts also use.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated weekend filter is an open copy within getNextDate, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The rule changes only in getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still apply getDateWithSkippedWeekend (move to Friday/Monday) to daily schedules.
